{{Quote|It's a mobile genetics unit, and I don't see what difference it makes whether it's racing odupiendos or humans that you're assessing. Except the dupies are worth a lot more.|[[Mereel Skirata]]|<ref name="RC:TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>}}
The '''odupiendo''', colloquially known as '''dupie''',<ref name="RC:TC" /> was a [[Bird/Legends|bird]]-like, bipedal [[Species/Legends|species]] that hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Although unable to fly, the odupiendos were fast runners. Taking advantage of that particular skill, the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] people had created a sport called [[odupiendo racing]], which involved several of those avian creatures running along a circular track. Such races were among the favorite betting sports in gambling places like the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Blog" /> and, for that reason, a stable of trained odupiendos was considered a highly valuable possession.<ref name="RC:501">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The odupiendo was originally designed for the ''[[Jendirian Valley/Legends|Jendirian Valley]]'' sequence of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref>
